decision.frozen_gate: At least two distinct critical project-impact misses are required before a dependency graph may enter root-cause review.
decision.reason: All four direct project impacts were found, the semantic-only control produced no false positive, and there were zero critical misses. Codex plus pinned local search is sufficient for this MVP sample.

quality_notes: The deterministic scorer derived one_sided evidence for every direct case because the baseline cited affected-project evidence but did not also cite the frozen change-project evidence.
The baseline proposed relevant new tests, but required_test_completeness remains 0.0 because the frozen metric requires exact project, path, and existing test selector matches.
The baseline's self-reported evidence_level values were not used by the scorer.
